objective: Harden long-running agent continuity over Worker/UI/API/network kills: durable PersistentGoal (goal_id/objective/status/progress_summary/started_at/last_progress_at/completion_criteria/blocked_reason) with CAS transitions, durable checkpoints at every mandated boundary (turn_boundary/tool_boundary/child_admission/child_completion/compaction/external_wait/terminal_state + manual/auto) as opaque JSON-serializable snapshots with host-authority isolation, and heartbeat with two roles (observability + control-plane liveness via fencing-aware renewal → cancellation). State must be deterministic after restart/lease takeover/network partition.

persistent_goal_contract.cas_guard: GoalLifecycle.transition validates legal/terminal and raises ConcurrentStateConflictError on expected_version mismatch; repository UPDATE ... WHERE version=:expected_version

durable_checkpoint_contract.opaque_snapshot: JSON-serializable dict, deep-copied on write and read, sanitize_snapshot strips HOST_FORBIDDEN_KEYS (credentials/provider/schedule/memory/learning/host_authority), ensure_json_serializable enforces opaque, assert_no_host_authority fails closed
durable_checkpoint_contract.sequence: per-agent_run_id monotonic sequence (MAX(sequence)+1 in transaction) + loop_version_at_checkpoint from agent_loop_states.version
durable_checkpoint_contract.fencing: fencing_token carried per checkpoint for stale-write protection, never host authority

heartbeat_hardening.two_roles: observability (worker_id/runtime_run_id/active_leases/metadata/recorded_at/history + determinism_snapshot) + control-plane liveness (fencing lease renewal via lease_manager/task_queue.renew; False -> fencing_rejected -> cancellation_hook -> cancelled_count)
heartbeat_hardening.existing_worker: apps/worker/windagent_worker/runner.py ProductionWorker + lease.py DurableTaskLeaseManager remain independent process authority; HeartbeatHardening is thin testable facade, no new daemon
heartbeat_hardening.determinism: history + cancelled_count preserved across ticks; heartbeat after restart creates new instance with same DB lease but independent runtime_run_id, yet prior ticks' durable checkpoints/goals survive (proved via checkpoint restart tests)

orchestration.goal_service: orchestration/windagent_orchestration/long_running/goal_service.py (CAS, event emit best-effort via MultiAgentRepository.append_event, no direct SQL in domain)
orchestration.checkpoint_service: orchestration/windagent_orchestration/long_running/checkpoint_service.py (validates kind/snapshot, sanitize, deep-copy, per-agent sequence, event emit best-effort, convenience at_* methods for every mandated boundary)
orchestration.no_bloat: OrchestratorService (~75KB) not inlined; Phase 5 capabilities live in narrow long_running seam (goal_service + checkpoint_service + heartbeat), worker stays claim/execute/heartbeat/checkpoint/recover/finalize only

storage.migration: 0022_long_running_hardening (forward-only, idempotent, upgrade creates persistent_goals + agent_checkpoints with indexes, downgrade drops both)
